text.formatted: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.
text.plain: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

text.formatted: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.
text.plain: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

text.formatted: The octopus can breathe only underwater.
text.plain: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is Grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is Restrained, and the octopus can't use its tentacles on another target.
text.plain: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is Grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is Restrained, and the octopus can't use its tentacles on another target.

text.formatted: A 20 foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around the octopus if it is underwater. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the Dash action as a bonus action.
